places.quote: it had been ignominiously given away in the Marshalsea, and had never got free to that hour
places.note: Debtors' prison where the Dorrits were held; the old prison-room is the same place.

places.quote: to look about him for his Paris purchases
places.note: Source of the purchases only; Dorrit has just returned from there.

places.quote: a touch of morning on the eastward rim of the desolate Campagna
places.note: Figurative setting for Dorrit's castle-building; the Campagna is the plain around Rome.

places.quote: as if he were going to lead her out into the Piazza of the people to walk a minuet by moonlight
places.note: Simile; identification with Piazza del Popolo is inferred from the name.
